lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three abbreviated line segments are visible on the anterior torso which terminate mid-flank without reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast circular white spots are visible on the lower posterior haunch, situated approximately halfway between the dorsal line and the hock.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with an initial lateral-posterior sweep followed by a medial-inward terminal turn.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory-toned tips comprise approximately 12-15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct white facial spots located sub-ocularly and mid-muzzle; prominent white dorsal crest extending from the neck to the upper rump.
